variant_rule: vXY: the animal at position X (1=tl,2=tr,3=bl,4=br) speaks at order Y
position_swap_rule: pZ: swap position of target (pos X) with animal at pos Z; speech order unchanged
time_swap_rule: tZ: swap speech order of target (order Y) with animal at order Z; positions unchanged
animal_swap_rule: anN: replace target animal with giraffe(1)/chicken(2)/frog(3); keep country & voice
country_swap_rule: cnN: replace target country with russia(1)/china(2)/brazil(3); keep animal & voice
